name: HybridAttentionMaskPreparation
reference:
import torch
import torch_npu

def run(batch_size, seq_length, past_key_values_length, num_attention_heads=64, swa_num_attention_heads=64, sliding_window=128):
    # No tensor inputs to infer device from; run on NPU when available so the
    # reference matches the solution's device. Fully vectorized (no Python
    # per-row loop) to stay fast on device.
    dev = "npu" if torch.npu.is_available() else "cpu"
    total_length = seq_length + past_key_values_length
    ones = torch.ones(batch_size, 1, total_length, total_length, device=dev)
    # full[i, j] = (j <= i + past): causal with past offset
    full_mask = ~torch.triu(ones, diagonal=past_key_values_length + 1).bool()
    if sliding_window is not None and sliding_window > 0:
        # swa[i, j] = (j <= i): lower-triangular (matches the original loop)
        swa_mask = torch.tril(ones).bool()
    else:
        swa_mask = full_mask
    return full_mask.expand(-1, num_attention_heads, -1, -1), swa_mask.expand(-1, swa_num_attention_heads, -1, -1)
description:
Hybrid causal mask preparation system that creates separate attention masks
for full attention and sliding window attention layers.
